title: Hims & Hers Announces Cost-Cutting Measures Amid Economic Challenges
digest: Hims & Hers announced on November 12, 2026, the reduction of three key expenses—marketing, R&D, and office space—to address current economic pressures. The decision aims to preserve cash flow and stabilize operations amid rising inflation and supply chain disruptions. Analysts note the cuts could temporarily slow product innovation and market expansion, though the company expects these measures to extend its financial resilience through 2027. A Seeking Alpha report from the same date details the cuts as part of a strategic recalibration, with no conflicting evidence from other sources.
